description: Key Features: Date Slider – Filter date-based data using an interactive timeline and calendar selector. It supports fixed intervals, preset values, and offers a flexible sliding experience for precise filtering. Calendar Date Picker – Select dates through multiple intuitive views: • Days View: Pick a single month range or multiple months, with the ability to quickly extend selections to previous or current periods with Today, Yesterday, Maximum, Minimum day option available Preset Bar Option: Present quick, predefined filter options as buttons for fast, one-click selections. Why Mahaaya Super Date Slicer? Because it provides precision, flexibility, and a seamless date-filtering experience, carefully crafted by the Mahaaya team.
